branch_diagnostic_definitions.observation_contract: Frozen policy observation shape (11,): branch errors are entries 7:9 for open and 9:11 for folded.
branch_diagnostic_definitions.branch_classification: Each post-step observation is assigned to the branch with the smaller Euclidean two-entry error norm; equal norms are assigned to open.
branch_diagnostic_definitions.occupancy: Occupancy counts classified post-step control states; fractions divide those counts by episode control steps.
branch_diagnostic_definitions.branch_switches: Count changes between consecutive classified post-step states; the reset observation is excluded.
branch_diagnostic_definitions.branch_at_first_reach: The branch at the first post-step state with held_steps greater than zero, or null when never reached.
branch_diagnostic_definitions.branch_at_max_held_run: The branch at the first post-step state setting a new maximum held_steps; ties keep the earlier attribution.
branch_diagnostic_definitions.minimum_error_norms: Minimum open and folded two-entry Euclidean error norms over all post-step observations.
